title: ETH Student Summer Research Fellowship
institution: ETH Zurich, Department of Computer Science

compensation.value: CHF 4,000 stipend for housing and living expenses; travel and visa costs covered
compensation.evidence_quote: Fellows receive a stipend of CHF 4,000 to cover housing and living expenses

about: Summer research fellowship at ETH Zurich computer science, 2 July to 27 August 2027, for bachelor and master students from other institutions. Applications via SiROP open 1 November and close 16 December 2026 at 13:00 CET.
requirements: Enrolled in a bachelor or master programme in computer science or a closely related field (e.g. electrical engineering, mathematics, physics)
Expected graduation in the year after the fellowship or later; two years of study completed by the programme start
Open to students worldwide except students enrolled at ETH Zurich
Apply via SiROP; only complete applications are considered; the deadline is never extended

upskill.name: Prompt Engineering for Research & Knowledge Work
why: "Computer science research" -> "Design prompts for reviewing literature, identifying themes, extracting research information, and comparing findings across multiple sources."
"Computer science research" -> "Transform documents and research material into structured representations such as evidence tables, summaries, taxonomies, and thematic syntheses."
